Messages.Author: James Hamblin
Messages.Body:
If I play Carrion Crows, is that damage considered inflicted by my
minion, or is it just envrionmental damage? For example, if I play
Carrion Crows, and my vampire and the opposing vampire punch for one,
can I play Disarm?

Relevant card texts:

Carrion Crows [Sabbat, SW]
Cardtype: Combat
Discipline: Animalism
Only usable before range is chosen. Opposing minion takes 1R damage
each
round of combat during strike resolution. A vampire can only play
one
Carrion Crows each combat. (S) As above, but with 2R damage.

Disarm [Sabbat, SW]
Cardtype: Combat
Discipline: Potence
Only usable at the end of a round of combat in which this vampire
successfully inflicted more damage at close range than the opposing
vampire; not usable by a vampire going into torpor. Put this card on
the
opposing vampire and send that vampire into torpor. The vampire with
this
card has -1 strength; he or she may burn this card by burning 3
blood. A
vampire can have only one Disarm. (S) As above, but the vampire with
this
card has -2 strength.

I think the answer to my question is "no", but I just want to make sure.

--
James Hamblin
ham...@math.wisc.edu

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
James Hamblin wrote:
>
> If I play Carrion Crows, is that damage considered inflicted by my
> minion, or is it just envrionmental damage? For example, if I play
> Carrion Crows, and my vampire and the opposing vampire punch for one,
> can I play Disarm?

Environmental. No.

> Relevant card texts:
>
> Carrion Crows [Sabbat, SW]
> Cardtype: Combat
> Discipline: Animalism
> Only usable before range is chosen. Opposing minion takes 1R damage each
> round of combat during strike resolution. A vampire can only play one
> Carrion Crows each combat. (S) As above, but with 2R damage.
>
> Disarm [Sabbat, SW]
> Cardtype: Combat
> Discipline: Potence
> Only usable at the end of a round of combat in which this vampire
> successfully inflicted more damage at close range than the opposing
> vampire; not usable by a vampire going into torpor. Put this card on the
> opposing vampire and send that vampire into torpor. The vampire with this
> card has -1 strength; he or she may burn this card by burning 3 blood. A
> vampire can have only one Disarm. (S) As above, but the vampire with this
> card has -2 strength.
>
> I think the answer to my question is "no", but I just want to make sure.

Correct. Relevant ruling:

Damage (Combat)

* Damage is only considered to have come from a minion if the
damage is from a strike or if an effect specifically states
that the damage is dealt by the minion. Damage from other
effects is considered "environmental," and has no particular
source. [RTR 30-JUN-1997]

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>If I play Carrion Crows, is that damage considered inflicted by my
>minion, or is it just envrionmental damage? For example, if I play
>Carrion Crows, and my vampire and the opposing vampire punch for one,
>can I play Disarm?

Speaking of environmental damage that deals damage during strike resolution:

A while back, there was this discussion over First Strike (I think) and there
was some question as to whether First Strike had a separate strike resolution.
So:

If Minion A has First Strike and will send Minion B to torpor, does Minion B's
Carrion Crows take into effect?

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
In message <20010412184058...@ng-fc1.aol.com>, Halcyan 2
<halc...@aol.com> writes

>If Minion A has First Strike and will send Minion B to torpor, does Minion B's
>Carrion Crows take into effect?

No, because combat is over (due to a minion being in torpor) before
"normal" strike resolution.
